card.name: Linking words before drug interaction terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, that, other, or, between, among) right where the next word would likely be 'interaction' or 'interact', mostly in drug interaction sections.

modes.label: Drug combination wording
modes.description: A linking word after a drug name or 'other drugs' where an interaction is about to be described.
modes.example: taking DRSP with other drugs<< that>> may affect electrolytes, such as ACE

modes.label: Interactions headings
modes.description: 'with' right after the word Interactions or a drug name in interaction headings.
modes.example: izers Interactions of Carvedilol Tablet<< with>> potent inhibitors of CYP2D6

modes.label: General integration wording
modes.description: Words like between, among or using in non-drug text about integration or communication.
modes.example: driving integration<< between>> data and knowledge from different disciplines, and

card.writes: It suppresses the word interaction and its forms, so it lowers the chance that the next word is 'interaction'.
card.plain: It fires on little words like 'with' or 'other' when the text is about to talk about things interacting, and it steers away from saying 'interaction' next.
